column3: #2659, CLOSED by #2669: the ceiling check, the `active` create and the role grant now all run under WithNamedLock(membershipLockKey(project, user)), the same key TransitionMembership takes, so a revoke can no longer land between the create and the grant (INV-CORE-44). The original reason's diagnosis was right (the only lock that applied was AssignUserRole's sodGrantLockKey("user"), inventory item 3, not item 10). No longer a guard hit — the function holds a named lock; staleness verified by deleting the row and confirming TestCheckThenActLockGuard_UnlockedSecurityCheck stays green. Proving tests: TestCTAReview_InviteMemberOpenMode_vs_Revoke_CrossReplicaPostgres (un-skipped, passes -count=20), TestInvariant6_MembershipLockIsLoadBearing_OpenModeInvite (re-fails with the lock mutated away).
